digest.component_or_area: Jira Cloud adapter — 429-retry sweep, config validation, probe resolved-status runtime configurability
propositions: Cloud transport mutations lack per-member 429 enumeration covering all four distinct retry boundaries (bare urlopen, pooled REST, ACLI subprocess, dispatch wrapper), risking undocumented retries causing duplicate writes
Cloud has no config-validation coverage for non-HTTPS rejection, missing-credential loudness, or malformed configuration propagation, contrasting with DC parity story
Cloud probe hardcodes RESOLVED_STATUS_NAMES without runtime configuration while DC threads resolved_statuses from settings, creating deployment inflexibility for non-standard Jira workflow states
DC exposes no user-search methods causing graceful degradation to string matching, but Cloud path lacks a pin test confirming DC-shaped transport does not raise on missing search capability
Per-member 429 retry assessment must document duplicate-write safety at each boundary (transport seam × dispatch level) as a repo artifact, not ticket-only, before any production change
